sources.title: Returns and Exchanges: Final sale items
sources.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Final sale items
Gift cards and items marked FINAL SALE at checkout cannot be returned or exchanged. Ski wax and other consumables that have been opened are also non-returnable.

sources.title: Returns and Exchanges: How to start a return
sources.text:
Returns and Exchanges, How to start a return
Email support@auroraoutfitters.com with your order number and the items you want to return. For US orders we reply within 1 business day with a prepaid return label and instructions. Canadian customers ship returns at their own cost to our Denver warehouse.

sources.title: Returns and Exchanges: Return shipping cost
sources.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Return shipping cost
A flat 7.50 USD return shipping fee is deducted from your refund when you use our prepaid label. Prepaid labels are for US returns: Canadian customers ship returns at their own cost, so no fee is deducted. The fee is waived entirely if the item arrived damaged, defective, or not as ordered.

sources.title: Returns and Exchanges: Return window
sources.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Return window
You have 30 days from the delivery date to start a return. Items must be unworn and unused, with original tags attached and original packaging included. Items showing wear, wash, or outdoor use cannot be accepted.
